[[Whispering Ritual Lord]] is an [[Irukandji]] [[boss]] that can be found in the [[Silent Surf]] [[explorable area]].

==Locations==
* [[The Jade Sea]]
** {{NPC location|Silent Surf}} (not during [[The Dragon Hunter]])

==Skills==
(20 [[Communing]] in [[hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Binding Chains}}
* {{skill icon|Disenchantment}}
* {{skill icon|Pain}}
* {{skill icon|Ritual Lord}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Soothing}}

==Items dropped==
* [[Black Pearl]]
* [[Decaying Mass]]
* [[Ritual Lord's Staff]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* The Whispering Ritual Lord does not [[spawn]] if [[The Dragon Hunter]] is active. This is evident by the presence of [[Turimachus]] directly outside the [[portal]] to [[Leviathan Pits]], or the presence of [[Saltspray Dragon Egg]]s in the vicinity of where Whispering Ritual Lord should be.
* Whispering Ritual Lord [[patrol]]s in a large area without a [[mob]]. However, due to the number of mobs in that area, it is advisable to clear some before engaging him, as it would be easy to accidentally [[aggro]] more than one mob when fighting.
* In hard mode, Ritual Lord does not increase its Communing rank, since [[attribute]]s are [[Effect stacking|capped]] at rank 20.
